name: food-delivery-platform
description: Full-Stack Gourmet Food Delivery Platform with Real-Time Socket.io Tracking

scripts.seed: node -e "require('dotenv').config({path:'./server/.env'}); const mongoose = require('./server/node_modules/mongoose'); const { seedDatabase } = require('./server/controllers/seedController'); mongoose.connect(process.env.MONGODB_URI).then(async () => { const req = {}; const res = { json: (d) => { console.log('Database seeded successfully:', d); process.exit(0); }, status: () => res }; await seedDatabase(req, res); }).catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); })"
